out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located in the warewahing area is blocked by multiple stacked plastic buckets, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CDI: CFM removed the stacked plastic buckets from the hand sink in the warewashing area to allow for easy access.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows:raw shelled eggs stored over RTE carrots inside the walk in refrigerator and raw shelled eggs stored above cooked pork inside the Migali 2 Dr preptop refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: CFM relocating raw shelled eggs to the bottom shelf inside the walk-in refrigerator and relocated the raw shelled eggs to the bottom shelf inside the Migali 2 Dr preptop refrigerator.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the quat sanitizer solution was measured over 400 ppm at the 3 vat sink. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food- contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of quat sanitizer solution between 200-300ppm. Verify concentration using the quat sanitizer test kit. CDI: CFM diluted quat sanitzer solution with water until solution was 250ppm. EHS instructed CFM to repair/ calibrate quat sanitizer dispenser at 3 vat sink to ensure appropriate concentration 200- 300ppm per the manufacturers instructions.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: fried eggs stored in bowl in the top part (not properly placed in the unit) of the Migali 2 Dr preptop refrigerator. CFM stated they intend to keep the fried eggs (fully cooked) cold while in storage.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. CDI: CFM relocated fried eggs to the walk in cooler to properly cool to 41F the relocated back to preptop refrigerator to for cold holding.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: squeeze bottles: oil, chili sauce/ oil, water on the cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CDI: CFM labeled squeeze bottles and all other food items removed from the original container with common food name.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Black plastic to-go bowls were found stored upward and uncovered on counter in the front service area.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches off the floor on NSF approved shelving units or dunnage racks. CDI: CFM covered black plastic to-go containers with plastic bag.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: Quat sanitizer dispenser not working properly at the 3 vat sink in the main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. CFM stated the quat sanitzer supplier/ tech will be onsite later today and will request repair on the quat dispenser at the 3 vat sink.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device (“Y splitter”) on the water supply system (mop sink in main kitchen).
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. CDI: CFM removed one of the hose from on side of the Y splitter (agreed to keep unattached).
